title: speech.rhvoice~
description: `speech.rhvoice~` performs RHVoice text-to-speech synthesis, accepting numbers, symbols, lists of symbols, SSML markup, or text/SSML files and producing TTS audio. Its voice, pitch, speaking rate, volume, and punctuation handling are configurable; RHVoice language and voice data files must be downloaded separately because they are not distributed with PureData-ceammc.
